articles.summary: Purchase expands non-medical product offerings and technology serving small and midsize employers The Hartford completed its acquisition of Equitable’s 1 Employee Benefits business, which represents approximately $500 million in premium in non-medical benefits and Equitable’s Employee Benefits technology. articles.summary: Insurer expands Shekar Pannala’s role as chief information officer to include Data and Artificial Intelligence Chief Claims Officer Stephen Deane’s role expanded to include Operations James M. Yanosy, current chief financial officer for Business Insurance, Employee Benefits, Claims and centralized services, named chief risk officer The Hartford announced expanded roles for two key executives, and appointed a new chief risk officer, in a leadership and organizational change that will take effect Nov. 2. Data and Artificial Intelligence will be combined with the Technology organization, under Chief Information Officer Shekar Pannala’s leadership. Chief Claims Officer Stephen Deane will oversee the company’s Operations in addition to his current role as head of Claims. Additionally, Chief Financial Officer for Business Insurance, Employee Benefits, Claims and centralized services, James M. Yanosy, has been named chief risk officer.
